title: the repository's whole wrote-path render population, split by spawnability and by what else announces the face

population_source.method: AST discovery over every .py source; a render call whose first argument's statically readable first word is 'wrote'

render.text: print('wrote state, heartbeat, round report row')
print(' wrote %s (%d B, side %d)' % (p, len(blob), side))
print(' wrote %s <- %s side (%d bytes)' % (path, side, len(b)))
print('wrote %s (bench %s, %d model(s) measured)' % (os.path.relpath(p, PATHS.root), b.get('measured_at'), len(b.get('results') or [])))

method_note: a spawn that does not capture stdout cannot be parsed by the spawner; a writer no source spawns is only run by a human; an unresolved message names no face this scan can see (published as unassessable, never as unannounced)
method_bound: spawn detection is static: a source that names the script inside a spawn function's arguments or a shell command line, nothing follows an alias or a variable-built path; announcement detection reads literals in sources and small *_latest.json pointer faces only
